name: Calf Stretch
pose: Standing split-stance calf stretch with rear heel grounded
accessibilityLabel: Standing calf stretch with the rear leg straight and heel planted, the front knee bent and hands resting on the front thigh.
prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: square original exercise-library illustration for a mobile workout app, target 1024x1024.
Input image: identity and rendering REFERENCE ONLY, the original curl illustration supplied here. Create a new exercise scene, not another curl.
Identity invariants: use the EXACT SAME adult grey mannequin identity, oval bald head, natural athletic build and muscle definition, body proportions, matte pale slate grey material, plain charcoal short training shorts and charcoal low-profile shoes as the reference. Same subdued studio lighting from upper left, flat very light cool-grey background #F3F5F7 with faint soft contact shadow, restrained premium 3D educational rendering. No brand identifiers or text.

Exercise: STANDING CALF STRETCH, unsupported split stance with hands resting on FRONT THIGH (no wall needed). Left foot forward, left knee moderately bent, both palms rest lightly on front thigh above knee. Right foot behind with right knee straight but not locked, rear toes point forward and WHOLE rear sole including HEEL planted firmly. Hips/trunk lean gently forward in same plane to stretch rear calf, back and neck neutral. Side-biased rear three-quarter view shows straight rear leg, grounded heel and exposed calf. Coral ONLY calf muscle bellies of rear RIGHT lower leg, no color on front leg/arms/trunk. Highlights indicate STRETCHED region, not contraction. No weights, box or other equipment. review.notes: Rear knee extended and heel firmly down, front knee bent with hands braced above it. Coral on rear calf only, highlights stretched region. Full feet/body and neutral-looking spine.
review.independentNotes: Independent visual review: front knee bent and rear leg straight with rear heel grounded, hands supported on front thigh. Coral marks the rear calf stretch target.
